MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 9 = 17. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 9
   D. 9

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

3. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 18

4. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 9
   C. 64
   D. 8

5. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 24
   D. 10

6. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 16

7. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 36
   C. 37
   D. 13

8. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 105
   C. 22
   D. 30

9. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.205
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.25

10. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 18 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 12 cm³

11. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 3
   D. 13

12. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

13. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 10

14. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 25
   C. 1
   D. 1

15. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 25
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

16. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 11
   D. 24

17. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

18. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 42

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 144
   D. 48

20. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

21. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

22. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

23. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 9
   C. 82
   D. 81

24. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
